{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for patients with severe disease
severe_df = df[df['severity'] == 'severe']

# Check the distribution of biomarker_baseline for severe patients
print(severe_df['biomarker_baseline'].describe())

# Check for any negative values or anomalies
print('\nNumber of negative baseline biomarker values in severe group:')
print((severe_df['biomarker_baseline'] < 0).sum())"}
